result.likely_cause: Catastrophic lithium-ion battery thermal runaway leading to internal combustion and explosion.
parts: None (device is beyond economic and safe repair)
steps: Do not attempt to power on, charge, or disassemble the device under any circumstances.
Allow the device to fully cool down in an open, well-ventilated area away from flammable materials.
Put on protective gloves, eye protection, and a mask to prevent contact with toxic residues and sharp debris.
Carefully place the damaged smartphone into a non-combustible metal container filled with sand or kitty litter.
Seal the container loosely to prevent pressure buildup while isolating the device from oxygen.
Store the container in a cool, dry outdoor location well away from living spaces and structures.
Contact your local municipal hazardous waste collection program or specialized lithium battery disposal facility immediately.
safety: CRITICAL FIRE HAZARD: Severed or ruptured lithium-ion cells can reignite spontaneously hours or days later.
TOXIC FUMES: Avoid inhaling smoke, gases, or dust particles produced by the battery combustion.
CHEMICAL BURNS: Do not touch leaked electrolyte fluid or caustic battery residue with bare hands.
SHARP EDGES: Shattered glass and torn metal frames present severe cut and puncture risks.
result.disposal: This device qualifies as hazardous waste due to a damaged/defective lithium-ion battery. Do not place it in household trash or standard recycling bins. Deliver it strictly to a certified hazardous household waste (HHW) facility or an e-waste handler equipped for damaged lithium batteries.

result.likely_cause: Severe mechanical impact causing shattered front glass and display assembly damage
steps: Cover the shattered front screen with clear packing tape to contain glass shards and allow suction cup adhesion.
Power off the device completely and remove the two pentalobe screws flanking the charging port.
Gently warm the perimeter of the screen with a hair dryer or heat gun (approx. 60-70°C) to soften the waterproof adhesive.
Attach a suction cup near the bottom and gently pry open the screen assembly from the side, being careful not to tear flex cables.
Unscrew the battery connector bracket and immediately disconnect the battery cable using a plastic spudger to prevent short circuits.
Unscrew the display cable bracket and disconnect the display and digitizer flex cables from the logic board.
Transfer the home button/Touch ID sensor and top speaker/camera assembly to the new screen (or use a fully pre-assembled unit).
Apply new perimeter adhesive, reconnect display and battery cables, test functionality before pressing the display back into place, and secure bottom screws.
safety: Lithium-ion battery hazard: Do not puncture, bend, or use sharp metal tools near the battery, as it can cause thermal runaway or fire.
Sharp glass hazard: Wear safety glasses and nitrile gloves to protect against loose glass splinters.
Disconnect battery first: Never connect or disconnect screen cables while the battery is attached to avoid blowing backlight fuses.
result.disposal: Take the shattered display assembly and any unusable parts to an authorized electronics recycling drop-off center; do not dispose of electronic glass in household trash.
